item.title: How to get the Scarecrow Song in Ocarina of Time
item.description: In The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, the Scarecrow Song is an optional but useful song you can unlock to help you get to otherwise impossible to reach places. You don't need the song to beat the game, but you will need it to get every Piece of Heart and Skulltula Token .

item.title: BoJack Horseman: A Top Animated Season in TV History
item.description: Occasionally, a TV show will come out that sticks with viewers even after they have finished watching it. Some seasons are even powerful enough to "enter the cultural zeitgeist as some of the best seasons. Shows like Breaking Bad , True Detective , and The Sopranos are all considered to have some of the best seasons of TV ever, praised for their grit, writing, and masterclass-level performances.

item.title: Nintendo Is Officially Investing in Game Preservation
item.description: Game preservation has always been one of the biggest problems facing the industry. According to the Video Game History Foundation , 87% of classic video games released in the United States are critically endangered or lost. This has forced many who want to maintain that history to turn to piracy, a last resort that has become a necessity due to the minimal efforts of large corporations to adequately preserve their catalog of games and technology. Thankfully, one of gaming's biggest names is officially getting in on the preservation effort.

item.title: Bandai Namco Shuts Down Once-promising Studio after Colossal Failure
item.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment, which published 2026 hits like Ace Combat 8 and The Blood of Dawnwalker , is shutting down one of its studios. Bandai announced on Tuesday that it is dissolving Reflector Entertainment, a studio it acquired in 2020 and had high hopes for beyond just its single game release.

item.title: Former Bioware Dev Reveals Incredibly Ambitious Pitch for Dragon Age 4
item.description: As fans reel from EA’s recent closure of BioWare , a former studio veteran revealed part of the internal pitch for a Dragon Age game that never came to be. Game developer Mark Darrah, who worked at BioWare from 1997 to 2021, shared part of a pitch book meant to “remain relevant” with the publisher.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Finally Proves Why Nintendo Needed the Switch 2
item.description: Every time a new video game console comes out, a long cycle of assessment begins. Companies like Sony tend to put their best foot forward on day one with visually spectacular games that sell their new hardware’s power, but the longer and more meaningful test comes in the years following launch. What is that hardware actually capable of doing once developers really get rolling with it? It can take a while to see that big picture. But it’s already clear as day when it comes to the Nintendo Switch 2, and that’s thanks to The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time .

item.title: Rockstar Issues Official Statement On GTA 6's PS5 Exclusive Features
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 fans are so excited about the game that many of them already bought a PlayStation 5 Pro in anticipation of Rockstar's open-world adventure. Funnily enough, Rockstar hadn't really told anyone what PS5 fans could expect on Sony's souped-up platform until now, just over a week before the game's official Nov. 19 release.

item.title: We Need More Games Like Murals
item.description: You might know Dlala from its 2020 take on Rare's vintage beat-em-up Battletoads , or from its 2023 Mickey Mouse platformer, Disney Illusion Island . Now it's time for the studio's "one for me," in the form of Murals , a combat-heavy isometric action-adventure that looks like Hades but is chasing something much simpler and more nostalgic: a linear cartoon romp full of wit and quirky charm.

item.title: 'Avatar' Officially Unveils a Very Different Version of Zuko in New Book
item.description: 2026 has been a fantastic year to be a fan of the Avatar franchise — the elemental fantasy saga, not the blue alien sci-fi movies. The animated sequel series Avatar: Seven Havens has been phenomenally successful, with a second season already confirmed, and Paramount Studios even has an Avatar fighting game that actually feels great to play. However, arguably the biggest win for Avatar fans this year was Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender . Set 12 years after Avatar: The Last Airbender ended, the movie reunited the gang for a new adventure. And even though it didn't get a theatrical release as originally promised, it was still a win for Team Avatar.

item.title: All active Escape From Tarkov codes and rewards
item.description: Escape From Tarkov promo codes are used in the classic extraction shooter for all sorts of rewards. From in-game gear and weapons to currency, cosmetics, and more, redeeming as many of these Tarkov codes as you can will set you up for your next raid. Especially since these goodies don't actually require a successful extraction to obtain them.
